name: Clover Revenge
source:
Can you survive in a land ruled by a ruthless kingdom?
Are you strong enough to be king?
Can you reclaim your rightful throne?
Become the hero of a story that will unfold according to your choices!​
translation:
你能在残酷王国统治的土地上生存吗？
你有足够的实力成为国王吗？
你能夺回你应有的王位吗？
成为故事的英雄，故事将根据你的选择展开！​
